name: owed-reread
means: Retiring a relation that realized a concept leaves the concept owing a re-read (owes) unless the projection survives in the same file or under the same name, or was a source; until concept revise or concept reaffirm answers it, impact counts it unresolved and every question it answers or stands on fails, and reconfirming the remaining projections does not clear it.
